info.title: Spectra Labs engine API
info.description: Reached only through the dashboard's server. Every /api route needs the HMAC headers X-Spectra-User, X-Spectra-Workspace, X-Request-Id, X-Spectra-Timestamp and X-Spectra-Signature (see crates/spectra-api/src/auth.rs). Timestamps are UTC RFC 3339; ids are UUIDv7; lists page with an opaque cursor.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: queued, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The file's name as the person chose it (for display; at most 255 characters kept).

requestBody.description: The file's bytes. Send X-Spectra-Content-SHA256 (signed) and Content-Length.

400.description: The body does not match its declared SHA-256 or length

413.description: Over 100 MiB, or the workspace's storage quota (code `quota_exceeded`)

get.summary:
Readiness: 200 when both the database and at least one worker answer,
otherwise 503. Compose starts the API and worker together after migrations.

200.description: The database and a worker are available

503.description: The database or worker is unavailable or not configured

BacktestListItem.description: One backtest in a list: what was asked for, its state and headline numbers.

cancel_requested.description: A cancel was asked for while it ran.

headline.description: `{total_return, sharpe, max_drawdown, final_equity, fill_count}`, once finished.

request.description: What was asked for: dataset version, strategy or strategies, params, config.

BacktestPage.description: A page of backtests, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

BacktestView.description: A backtest as the API shows it.

artifacts.description: Stored files `[{kind, file_name, content_type, sha256, size}]`, once finished.

cancel_requested.description: A cancel was asked for while it ran.

error.description: Why it failed (or the latest retryable error).

fingerprints.description: Engine, dataset, config, result and strategy hashes, once finished.

id.description: The job id (UUIDv7); use it for every `/backtests/{id}` route.

progress.description: 0..1, updated with every worker heartbeat while it runs.

request.description: What was asked for: dataset version, strategy, params, config.

summary.description: Metrics, drawdown, tail, activity and trade statistics, once finished.

CreateBacktest.description: `POST /api/v1/backtests` body: the `backtest` job payload, plus a priority.

dataset_version_id.description: A dataset version of the caller's workspace.

params.description: Strategy parameters; missing ones take their defaults.

strategies.description:
Several strategies on one account: `[{"strategy", "params", "weight"}]`,
each `weight` a share of the starting cash (adding up to at most 1).

strategy.description:
A built-in strategy name (see `GET /api/v1/strategies/builtin`).
Give either `strategy` (with `params`) or `strategies`.

payload.description: The same body the matching synchronous route takes.

DatasetList.description: The workspace's dataset versions, newest first.

DatasetVersionView.description: A dataset version a backtest can run on.

detail.description: Deprecated copy of `message`, removed with the `/api/...` aliases.

IngestColumns.description: Header names (matched without regard to case).

symbol.description: Symbol column, or null for a single-symbol file (then `default_symbol`).

volume.description: Volume column, or null if the file has none (volume is then zero).

dataset_name.description:
The dataset to add a version to (created if new). Different content
becomes its next version; the same content changes nothing.

settings.description: How to read the file (as previewed).

IngestSettings.description:
Ingest settings (the JSON form of the engine's CSV options). Every field
below without "optional" must be given: nothing is guessed.

columns.description: Which header name holds each field.

default_symbol.description: The symbol for every row when `columns.symbol` is null; not allowed otherwise.

delimiter.description: One punctuation character (not `"`) or a tab.

skip_bad_rows.description: Optional, default `false`: bad rows abort the load. `true` skips and counts them.

utc_offset_minutes.description:
Minutes east of UTC for ISO timestamps written without a zone
(-720 to 840). A fixed offset: daylight saving is not modelled.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

JobView.description: A job as the API shows it (the payload is not echoed: it can be megabytes).

cancel_requested.description: A cancel was asked for while it ran.

header.description: The header, trimmed and lower-cased (how columns are matched).

quality.description:
The quality report of the parsed rows. Every bad row in the sample is
counted here, whatever `skip_bad_rows` says.

rows.description: Up to 200 parsed rows, sorted by timestamp then symbol. Prices are exact decimal text.

rows_not_read.description: Data rows in the sample beyond the first 200, not parsed.

would_abort.description:
Why ingesting would stop with these settings (the first bad row when
bad rows abort, or "no valid data rows"); null if these rows would load.

sample.description: The start of the file as UTF-8 text, header included (at most 1 MB).

oneOf.description: Ingest settings. Omit them to get only `suggestions`.

truncated.description:
`true` when `sample` was cut from a longer file: its last line may be
incomplete, so it is ignored.

oneOf.description: The sample parsed with `settings`; null when no settings were sent.

suggestions.description: Proposals from the sample, for the person to confirm. Never applied.

QualityReport.description: A dataset's quality report (also what a dataset version stores).

bars_sha256.description: Fingerprint of the bars (recorded in backtest results).

first_ts_ns.description: First bar, nanoseconds since the epoch.

input_was_sorted.description: Whether rows arrived sorted by timestamp and symbol.

last_ts_ns.description: Last bar, nanoseconds since the epoch.

rows_rejected.description: Rows dropped (only when bad rows are skipped).

gap_factor.description: A gap is an interval longer than this many median intervals (default 5).

outlier_z.description: Robust z-score of a close-to-close return that counts as an outlier (default 10).

stale_run.description: Frozen bars in a row that count as a stale run (default 5).

horizon_days.description: Horizon in trading days, up to 7,560. Default 252.

Suggestions.description: Suggested settings; null where there is no confident guess.

columns.description: Header names matched by common aliases.

delimiter.description: Delimiter that splits every sampled row into the same number of fields.

header.description: The header split with that delimiter, as written.

timestamps_have_zone.description: For ISO timestamps: whether they carry a zone (then the UTC offset does not apply to them).

stale_runs.description: Runs of `stale_run` or more frozen bars.

expires_at.description: Removed at this time unless ingested (UTC, RFC 3339).
